fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2011 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $32.8 million for the year ended December 31, 2011.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in recent years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense increased $47.5 million, or 14.4%, to $378.2 million for 2012, up from $330.7 million 2011. This change was due to a 10.4% increase in system gallons consumed from 107.6 million to 118.8 million.
